working_definition: "unpg(+) lPNs": lateral-lineage antennal-lobe olfactory projection neurons (41 cells) within Davie et al. 2018 res-2.0 cluster 27, expressing the POU-domain transcription factor unplugged (unpg), reproducing a Li et al. (2017) SMART-seq2 subcluster. Uni- or multiglomerular, projecting via mACT to lateral horn and mushroom body calyx. The report explicitly flags unpg as a combinatorial transcriptomic marker of uncertain anatomical specificity.
searches_performed: adult antennal lobe projection neuron lPN

best_match.fbbt_term: adult antennal lobe projection neuron lPN
best_match.fbbt_definition: Adult antennal lobe projection neuron that belongs to the dorsal (Notch OFF) hemilineage of the lateral antennal lobe neuroblast (ALl1) (Lin et al., 2012; Bates et al., 2020). Its cell body is located in the lateral part of the cell body rind of the antennal lobe.

justification: No FBbt term is built on the unpg (unplugged) marker or cites Li et al. 2017 / Davie et al. 2018 for this subgroup (searched directly - no hits). The report concludes it is not established whether unpg(+) lPNs is one of the six PN classes Li et al. (2017) 'unequivocally mapped' to a known glomerulus, so it should be treated as a transcriptomic subgroup of uncertain specificity. The cluster IS-A adult antennal lobe projection neuron lPN (FBbt:00007439) but the distinguishing unpg+ marker is not captured by any FBbt term.
recommendation: Broad-match to the lPN lineage term; do not mint a new term given unconfirmed anatomical specificity. Both flags left false per dataset guidance.
